name: store.apex-tat-va.www/ayurveda-herbal-botanical-provenance-manuscript-citation-seal-remedy-tcm-unani-siddha-tibetan-wellness
title: Apex Tatva — Ayurveda, Herbal & Botanical Provenance with Manuscript Citations
description: 4-tier provenance and SHA-256 seals for ayurvedic, herbal, botanical records. Not medical advice.

tools.name: search_provenance
tools.description: Search botanical provenance records by herb name, category or a traditionally described use. Each record has four tiers (manuscript source, research status, recorded cautions, disagreements) and a SHA-256 seal.

query.description: Herb name, category or traditional use, e.g. 'ashwagandha' or 'sleep'.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

tools.name: get_provenance_record
tools.description: Fetch one provenance record by its id (from search_provenance or list_records), with its four tiers and SHA-256 seal.

tools.name: list_records
tools.description: List the id, name and category of every provenance record currently in the corpus.

tools.name: verify_record_seal
tools.description: Check a SHA-256 seal you stored earlier against the current record. Tells you whether the record is unchanged since that hash was taken.

id.description: Record id the hash belongs to.

hash.description: The 64-character SHA-256 seal hash you stored.

tools.name: search_canon
tools.description: Search the 150-text canonical corpus of classical botanical and medical traditions. Returns the source texts behind the provenance records: title, author, era, tradition or pillar, synopsis, a defining quoted line, and topic domains. Use this to locate the manuscript a claim originates in.

query.description: Text title, author, tradition, pillar or topic, e.g. 'Charaka', 'Tibetan', 'Pulse' or 'Nighantu'.

limit.description: Maximum number of canon entries to return.

tools.name: get_canon_text
tools.description: Fetch one canonical source text by id (from search_canon). Returns its full record: title and native title, author, era, tradition or pillar, language, chapter and verse counts, synopsis, defining quoted line, and topic domains.
